jinx.reason: An Alchemist-Baffler has no Baffler ability. If they vote on every nomination and speak like a baffled player during the day, they learn a piece of true info tonight.
The Alchemist's announced words might be false.
If the Alchemist-Watcher chooses an evil player, they receive false information.
Each night*, the Armageddon chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Banshee dies & gains their ability.
If the Armageddon is drunked by the Courtier, the Storyteller chooses which 3 players live on Night 4.
The Devil's Advocate has no ability during armageddon.
The Evil Twin has no ability during armageddon.
If the Armageddon nominates and executes the Exorcist-chosen player, good wins.
Each night*, the Armageddon chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Farmer uses their ability but does not die.
The Goon has no ability during armageddon.
If the Armageddon is in play and the Grandchild dies by execution, evil wins.
If the Armageddon nominates and executes an Innkeeper-protected player, good wins.

The Armageddon does not learn Journalist picks. Each night*, the Armageddon chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): if a Journalist-chosen player is chosen, the Journalist learns a true statement, even if dead.
If the Armageddon is in play, and at least 1 player is dead, the King learns an alive character each night.
If the Armageddon nominates and executes the Monk-protected player, good wins.
Each night*, the Armageddon chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): if a Pathologist-chosen player is chosen, the Pathologist learns the Armageddon is in play.
Each night*, the Armageddon chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Ravenkeeper uses their ability but does not die.
Each night*, the Armageddon chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Sage uses their ability but does not die.
If the Armageddon nominates and executes the Soldier, good wins.
If the Lycanthrope kills a good player, the Arsonist chosen player isn't poisoned.
If the Princess nominates & executes on their first day, the Arsonist must choose a player, but they don't become poisoned.
Players poisoned by the Xaan don't count for the Arsonist's ability.
If the Barber turns an evil player into the Portia Featherington, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
If the Barber turns an evil player into the Sympath, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
Any good Minions that has a jinx with Alchemist will have the modified ability the jinx reads.
The Demon cannot have the Portia Featherington ability.
The Demon cannot have the Sympath ability.
If the Armageddon is created from the Hatter after Night 4, armageddon happens on the Armageddon's second day.
The Chambermaid can detect if the Informant will wake tonight.
Each night*, the Leviathan chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): if a Pathologist-chosen player is chosen, the Pathologist learns the Leviathan is in play.

The Leviathan does not learn Journalist picks. Each night*, the Leviathan chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): if a Journalist-chosen player is chosen, the Journalist learns a true statement, even if dead.
One additional Townsfolk might become evil.
If the Lolth is summoned, a Townsfolk might become evil.
The Informant can detect if the Mathematician will wake tonight.
If the Princess nominated & executed a player on their 1st day, the Princess learns if an Armageddon is in play tonight.
If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Portia Featherington, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Sympath, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
Each night*, Riot chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): if a Pathologist-chosen player is chosen, the Pathologist learns Riot is in play.

Riot does not learn Journalist picks. Each night*, Riot chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): if a Journalist-chosen player is chosen, the Journalist learns a true statement, even if dead.
When Daki creates Gyutaro, the Scarlet Woman remains the Scarlet Woman.
If the Summoner summons an Armageddon, armageddon happens on the Armageddon's second day.
The Baffled player might register as evil to the Vizier.
The Vizier might not be able to push on a Jester that claimed Jester during their defense.
The Vizier isn't announced if the Secretary saw the Vizier.
